en: The image is a vintage, monochrome postcard showing a bustling town square with numerous horse-drawn carriages and people in period dress. The background features a large Gothic-style church with prominent buttresses and a spire, surrounded by classic European buildings with gabled roofs and multiple windows. The words 'KRONSTADT.' and 'MARKTPLATZ.' are printed at the bottom edges of the postcard.
